title: Hearing on rent freeze programs for seniors and disabled tenants
summary: The Council's Aging, Disabilities and Finance Committees held a joint oversight hearing on the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption (SCRIE) and Disability Rent Increase Exemption (DRIE) programs, which freeze rent for low-income older and disabled tenants earning $50,000 or less. The hearing also covered related bills on application processes, income eligibility thresholds, eviction protections and informational notices, plus several resolutions urging state action on rent freeze and homeowner tax exemption rules. Witnesses invited included the Department for the Aging, Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities, Department of Finance and Department of Housing Preservation and Development.
